messages:
rachael: quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A 1 small batch of manager/IC questions that didn't get answered live. posting here so it's searchable.
gracie: thanks! first Q: can managers add an 'Acting-' prefix to titles for temporary transfers so org charts reflect current work?
lina: yes, short term prefixes are allowed for clarity. People Ops will add an 'acting_title' field in the HR record for transfers lasting <90 days. it won't change base comp or level.
devon: will we harmonize comp bands if someone moves into a team with different market bands? worried about surprises.
matt: comp bands follow the person. if the new org has materially different bands and the manager wants to align, file a comp-eval request. Finance + Comp will review; expected turnaround ~7 business days for typical cases.
anita: can we standardize an onboarding buddy for transferred folks so they have a single person to ask about team norms? saves friction.
lina: agreed. managers should assign a buddy in the receiving team for 2 weeks. People Ops will add a buddy-assignment checkbox to the Manager Handoff checklist.
grace: OKR impact: should teams update their OKRs if headcount shifts affect deliverables?achael: yes 1 managers should update OKRs and note headcount changes in the weekly roadmap sync. PM leadership will review significant scope changes during quarterly check-ins.
devon: any guidance on mentorship programs? some ICs fear losing mentor relationships after transfers.
lina: mentorship continuation encouraged. if mentor moves org, please keep meetings for at least 30 days while a new mentor is identified. People Ops will ask mentors to note mentorship status in profiles to ease rematching.
anita: question on interview scorecards 1 do panels need to be re-trained for bias risks during high-mobility?
matt: good call. Talent will publish a 10-min refresher on fair interviewing and score normalization this week. panels should keep scorecards consistent across transfers.
legal-bot: note: "people-ops/acting-prefix-guidance.md" published to repo at 2501234605
grace: will transferred managers have a performance review window shifted if they move mid-cycle?
lina: reviews keep the same cadence. managers should preserve feedback and include transferee's prior-manager input in calibration. People Ops will provide a transferee review checklist.
devon: relos: any change to relocation stipends or approvals if someone transfers org but stays city?achael: relocation policy unchanged. internal org transfers without physical moves don't trigger relocation. if transfer includes location move, follow the standard relocation approval path.
anita: can teams request a temporary "shadow rotation" for 2-4 weeks instead of immediate transfer to test fit?
lina: yes 1 shadow rotations allowed and encouraged. log them in Talent Marketplace; they count as a dotted-line assignment and should be visible to Talent/Finance.
grace: will there be a final retro after wave-2 to collect lessons and update the playbook?achael: yes 1 retro + playbook update scheduled 10 business days after wave-2 close. invite will go to managers, EngOps, Talent, and a rotating set of ICs.
devon: tiny ask: can we get a one-line manager script for announcing "acting" titles to customers? keeps messaging consistent.
lina: will add a customer-safe script to manager templates.
anita: what about title prefixes in external systems (GitHub, slack display names)? any policy?achael: internal systems ok; external-facing profiles should avoid temporary prefixes unless Customer Communication sign-off obtained. use role descriptions instead.
leg al-bot: compliance-note: any transfer impacting export-controlled projects requires Legal pre-approval. flag early.
rachael: thanks all. publishing a short FAQ, manager scripts, and the acting-title guide today. will ping when live. :thumbsup:
__notes: All-hands follow-up focused on acting-title prefixes, comp harmonization, onboarding buddy, OKR updates, mentorship continuity, interview bias refresher, shadow rotations, retro scheduling, and legal/ export controls. Short Slack-style messages, doc publish note, and manager guidance requests.
